services.name: Aerial Photo Special
services.desc: Take advantage of our Instagram Special to book an incredible helicopter tour over Los Angeles. Details L.A. is a beautiful city, offering many attractions for tourists and locals alike. Our downtown Los Angeles tour provides you with a fantastic chance to see all the beautiful scenery from high above. Departing from and returning to the Long Beach Airport with views of the Staples Center, LA Coliseum, and Dodger Stadium, this tour offers big sights for a big deal. Extra flight time is charged at $60 for the aircraft for every 0.1 hours. Should you wish to start your flight after sunset there $99 PP for 3 passengers total • $149 PP for 2 passengers total • 30 min flight time

quotes.author: gonzjed
quotes.text: Clear, beautiful blue skies. Excellent pilot (Kate) who narrated interesting points throughout the trip. The helicopter has great views obviously, but air vents to make a comfortable flight. Thank you for a memorable trip!
It was an awesome experience. It was our 18th Wedding Anniversary. We didn't know what to do we literally booked last minute the night before .they accommodate us.we were very grateful.

quotes.author: Dyamond
quotes.text: First time in a helicopter and it was exciting, the pilot Calum was awesome & very polite. Would definitely recommend and the staff was great. Easy booking and will be coming back.
Going over the marina our pilot was awesome it was the best first time experience ever just enough time to make you want more.
The pilots were fun they have a fun sense of humor makes the experience a lot easier for those that are scared of heights.
